| **Qwen"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"-Image-2.1** | final assets, legible in-image text, precise composition | tens of seconds | yes |"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"The second is everything else: ComfyUI already ships **116 workflow templates

3D, music and audio. This plugin makes all of them drivable from the agent."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"## What it registers"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"- **`comfyui_generate`** — text-to-image, one prompt in, tuned parameters out.

- **`comfyui_run_template`** — run a template and save its output.
- *"},{"id":"p9s4","text":"*`comfyui_status`** — report what is installed and ready. Useful when a
generation fails.
- **Skill "},{"id":"p9s5","text":"`comfyui-image`** — model selection, prompt craft, sampler tuning and
negative-prompt support, so th"},{"id":"p9s6","text":"e agent chooses deliberately."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"## The template catalogue"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"ComfyUI stores its templates as **browser graphs**: canvas coordinates, link
objects, and the real g"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"raph wrapped in a subgraph. `/prompt` accepts none of
that — it wants the API form. The server has n"},{"id":"p11s3","text":"o conversion path; it exists only
in the frontend's JavaScript."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"`lib/blueprint.js` is that conversion. Each part of it was a real bug:"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"- subgraph unwrapping, because a template's top-level node type is a UUID
- widget alignment, becaus"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"e `widgets_values` is positional over *widget* inputs
only and a seeded widget is followed by its co"},{"id":"p13s3","text":"ntrol-after-generate setting —
get it wrong and every later value lands on the wrong input
- depende"},{"id":"p13s4","text":"ncy order, because the canvas stores nodes in creation order, so
converting in file order drops requ"},{"id":"p13s5","text":"ired inputs and ComfyUI blames a node
several steps away
- `Reroute` is a splint, not a decoration: "},{"id":"p13s6","text":"dropping it severs every link behind it
- a *bypassed* node is not in the submitted graph at all. Wh"},{"id":"p13s7","text":"en nothing consumes
its output it is simply dropped; when something does, the consumer is rewired
to"},{"id":"p13s8","text":" an upstream output, and that rewire is type-checked — a bypassed
`PreviewAny` can be carrying a STR"},{"id":"p13s9","text":"ING from two wildcard hops away, and
connecting to the first wildcard would hand a non-string to
`CL"},{"id":"p13s10","text":"IPTextEncode.text`
- template defaults live on the node an exposed input feeds, not at the top level"},{"id":"p13s11","text":"
- templates ship no `SaveImage`, and the executor persists only `OUTPUT_NODE`
results, so one is ap"},{"id":"p13s12","text":"pended on a collision-free id"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"All 348 template files convert cleanly across 67 model families. The 117 that
are skipped afterwards"},{"id":"p14s2","text":" are not conversion failures — they are templates that
drive no sampler at all (colour grading, crop"},{"id":"p14s3","text":"ping, captioning), where there is
nothing to render."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"Whether a template can actually *run* is a separate question, and it is answered

not on this machine is refused before it reaches the executor, with the missing
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"## Downloads go through a mirror"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"Model weights come from `hf-mirror.com` by default. The interesting part is not
the URLs the plugin "},{"id":"p17s2","text":"prints — it is that **the ComfyUI process is started with
`HF_ENDPOINT` set**, because `huggingface_"},{"id":"p17s3","text":"hub` reads that variable at import
time and rewrites every URL it builds from then on. Without it th"},{"id":"p17s4","text":"e plugin can
hand you a mirror link and ComfyUI still crawls to huggingface.co the moment you
instal"},{"id":"p17s5","text":"ou a mirror link and ComfyUI still crawls to huggingface.co the moment you
install anything by hand."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"Override it when the direct origin is reachable:"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"`HF_HUB_ENABLE_HF_TRANSFER` is deliberately left off: it selects a Rust
downloader the mirror does n"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"ot serve, so turning it on turns a slow download
into a failed one."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"The plugin still downloads nothing on its own initiative. It reports the files,
their sizes, their l"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"icences and the free space left, and fetches only when you
pass `download=true` after reading that r"},{"id":"p21s3","text":"s and the free space left, and fetches only when you
pass `download=true` after reading that report."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"## The knowledge layer"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"Capability is not the hard part — knowing how to *drive* a model is. The
catalogue supplies each tem"},{"id":"p23s2","text":"plate's default values, but not the reasoning, so
`lib/model-knowledge.js` records what each family "},{"id":"p23s3","text":"needs: sampler ranges,
negative-prompt support, text-rendering reliability, and prompt hints."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"Every value is read back out of the local blueprints rather than written from
memory, and anything u"},{"id":"p24s2","text":"nverified is marked as such."},{"id":"p25s1","text":"The reasoning catches things that fail silently. Z-Image-Turbo wires its
sampler's negative slot to "},{"id":"p25s2","text":"a node that zeroes it, so **a negative prompt
produces a byte-identical image instead of an error**."},{"id":"p25s3","text":" An agent that does not
know this will "refine" a prompt and change nothing at all."},{"id":"p26s1","text":"## Requirements"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"- **Comfy Desktop** with the model templates installed (it ships a "Z-image" and
a "Qwen-Image-2.1" "},{"id":"p27s2","text":"template), **or** any ComfyUI checkout that has the model
weights on disk.
- **DeepSeek Harness** 0."},{"id":"p27s3","text":"2.0-rc.2 or newer.
